title: Regent Taipei · Immersive Banquet
description: Floral imagery unfolds across the banquet space at Regent Taipei. Projection brings the room’s walls and architectural surfaces into a shared visual atmosphere, surrounding the dining setting with light and colour.

title: Linkou Lightning House · Stunning Transformation
description: Architectural projection mapping transforms the facade of Linkou’s Lightning House into a luminous night-time canvas. The building’s distinctive structure and an outdoor audience become part of a shared light-and-music experience.

title: L’Oréal 30th Anniversary
description: For L’Oréal’s 30th anniversary, recyclable materials and interactive light formed a Tree of Sustainability. A contactless digital guest check-in system brought together public-health needs and digital aesthetics during the pandemic. The installation explored the relationship between beauty, environmental responsibility and digital art.

title: Kinmen Kaoliang · It’s Me Bar
description: For Kinmen Kaoliang’s It’s Me Bar, interactive floor projection drew in passersby. Window projection and 3D projection mapping presented changing brand content, while the distillery’s logo became the basis for a projection wall exploring a younger brand image.
